newsitem.title: USA: Wilmington Trust silver stocks 58.7 mln ounces.
newsitem.headline: Wilmington Trust silver stocks 58.7 mln ounces.

text.p: Wilmington Trust deliverable silver stocks rose 1,993 ounces to 58,784,962 ounces as of October 15, the COMEX division of the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said Wednesday.
Wilmington Trust in Delaware becomes an official exchange silver depositary from January 1, 1997.
COMEX silver warehouse stocks, excluding Wilmington Trust silver stocks, rose 202,149 ounces to 130,946,171 ounces Monday.
NYMEX will report Wilmington Trust data weekly until January 2, 1997 when Wilmington's eligible and registered silver stocks in the exchange's daily metal warehouse data.
